alphabetical letter ه
[The twenty-sixth letter of the alphabet; called هَآءٌ: it is one of the class termed حَلْقِيَّةٌ [or guttural], and is a radical letter, except when written with two dots, ة; for which, and for the pronominal values of ه, &c., see the Supplement. ―
-b2- As a numeral it denotes five.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
